cost.h1: The supplier invoice is not the cost.
cost.subheadline: Freight, customs, brokerage, insurance, cold storage, and shrink get added later—and nobody knows the true landed cost of a lot until 3 weeks after it's already sold.

excel.h1: Still running your distribution business on spreadsheets, notebooks, and WhatsApp?
excel.subheadline: When purchasing, cold storage, dispatch, and accounting live in disconnected files, one unallocated freight bill or shrink adjustment silently wipes out your margin on the entire load.

erp.h1: The operating and financial system built for wholesale produce distribution.
erp.subheadline: Connect lot-level landed costs, perishable inventory, customer orders, dispatch, and accounts payable in one real-time system—built for $5M to $100M US produce distributors.

problem.h2: Your grower invoice says $42,000. What did that container of avocados actually cost you?
problem.lead: You receive a container of avocados with a $42,000 grower invoice. Your sales team prices the load off that invoice and moves it in four days. Three weeks later, the freight bill, customs entry, cold storage invoice, and repacking shrink land on accounting's desk.
problem.body: By the time your bookkeeper reconciles the month in QuickBooks and Excel, the fruit is long gone, the customer paid, and you have no idea which lots made money and which ones bled cash.
problem.marginCallout: In a business operating on 2–4% net margins, how you allocate those costs decides whether that container made money or lost money.

howItWorks.h2: Two parallel flows running as one system—not two worlds reconciled once a month.
howItWorks.subtitle: Every commercial movement on the warehouse floor automatically updates its financial counterpart at the lot level. No double entry, no end-of-month surprises.
howItWorks.syncNote: Live Lot-Level Sync: When freight, customs, or cold storage hits Accounts Payable, ADDNEXO immediately updates the unit cost in Inventory and recalculates net margin on every Customer Invoice.

differentiator.h2: Inventory stops being a quantity on hand and becomes a measurable economic unit.
differentiator.subtitle: Counting boxes tells you what is sitting in the cooler. ADDNEXO tells you the exact financial performance of every single lot from receiving dock to final collection:

metrics.title: What was lost

metrics.title: What it earned

metrics.title: What the real gross margin was
metrics.desc: True net contribution per container, per grower, and per salesperson while you still have time to adjust pricing.

credibility.quote: “The hard part of vertical ERP is not writing the software — it's knowing what a distributor does at 4 a.m. when a truck arrives short.”
credibility.h2: Born inside a Miami wholesale produce distributor—not a Silicon Valley incubator.
credibility.p1: ADDNEXO didn't start as a generic software idea looking for an industry. It started on the dock of a wholesale produce distributor in Miami who was tired of flying blind on container margins and paid nearly $6,000 upfront to get this exact problem solved first.
credibility.p2: That first Miami distributor is still in production today, running their complete purchasing, landed costing, inventory, dispatch, invoicing, and financial cycle on ADDNEXO every single day.
credibility.p3: Behind the platform is a team with decades of real operational distribution experience (built on our SICOM operational foundation)—people who understand repacking, short trucks, USDA holds, and 4 a.m. receiving.

faq.h2: Direct answers before you book your call.

items.q: Is ADDNEXO only for fresh produce distributors?
items.a: It was engineered specifically around the hardest problems in wholesale fresh produce—lot traceability, post-invoice landed costs (freight, customs, cold storage), perishability, and shrink. If you distribute produce, meat, seafood, dairy, or imported perishables where lot margins move daily, it fits your operation out of the box.

items.q: How long does implementation actually take?
items.a: Days to a couple of weeks—not the 6 to 12 months required by NetSuite, Famous, or Prophet. We import your active products, suppliers, and customers, configure your landed cost categories, and get your team running real lots immediately.

items.q: Do I have to abandon Excel overnight?
items.a: No. We transition your operation progressively—starting with purchasing, lot receiving, and landed costing so you stop losing margin immediately, while importing your existing spreadsheets cleanly without disrupting daily dispatch.

items.q: Can it be customized to my specific operation?
items.a: Yes. Because we built the platform from the ground up with real distributors, we adapt cost allocation rules, receiving workflows, invoice formats, and operational reports to match how your warehouse and buyers actually work.

items.q: Does it calculate the true landed cost of inventory automatically?
items.a: Yes. As soon as you attach freight, customs, brokerage, cold storage, handling, or shrink to a purchase or import lot—even if bills arrive days apart—ADDNEXO automatically recalculates the exact unit cost and real gross margin of every box in that lot.

items.q: What happens during the 15-minute diagnostic call?
items.a: No slide decks and no generic software pitch. We look at how you currently track lots, allocate freight/customs/shrink, and reconcile invoices between your floor and accounting. In 15 minutes, we'll show you exactly where margin is leaking and tell you honestly if ADDNEXO fits your operation.
